accommodation.title: Where You Stay
accommodation.description: We believe accommodation should be an organic continuation of your journey, chosen for character, authenticity, and profound connection with the landscape.

principles.title: Distinct Character
principles.description: Historic villas, stone houses, and intimate family properties shaped by heritage.

principles.title: Exceptional Setting
principles.description: Positioned directly inside ancient walls, beside secluded bays, or amidst alpine tranquility.

principles.title: Subtle Luxury
principles.description: Generous spaces, exquisite linens, and effortless comfort without ostentation.

principles.title: Warm Connection
principles.description: Hosts who greet you by name and offer intimate insights into regional customs.

accommodation.destinationsDescription: Each destination on your route offers a distinct type of stay. Below we outline the character and setting of accommodation at each stop — exact properties are confirmed personally during the booking process.

stays.description: An intimate, design-forward retreat situated near the leafy Blloku quarter, blending Ottoman details with modern craft.
A lovingly preserved stone lodge surrounded by jagged peaks, offering homemade mountain cheeses and fireside conversation.
Handcrafted timber rooms perched alongside the crystalline Valbona river with sweeping canyon vistas.

accommodation.standardsDescription: Independent character, quiet settings, and thoughtful local hospitality are non-negotiable across every property.
expectations: Private en-suite bathroom in all rooms

visualReference.title: Atmospheric Details
visualReference.description: A glimpse into the textures, morning views, and secluded gardens awaiting you.
